summary: Lando Norris won the Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, 22.9s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P14 to P8.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P17.
The stewards penalised STR (5 second time penalty).
There were 26 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 70 points over Lando Norris.
